key_reasoning.reason: New deployable sync container (Dockerfile.sync), Helm CronJob, KeycloakSyncCoordinator with _reconcile_user/_reconcile_memberships/_sync_budget, standalone entrypoint process, and require_no_idp_lock() guard injected across 3 routers (user_management_router, projects, common) and 2 services (authentication_service, user_access_service). Keycloak used as a scheduled sync data source — a new integration pattern beyond the existing auth-only client — triggered the 'Integration with new external service' bump from XL to XXL.

Advisory lock (_LOCK_ID) for coordinator idempotency, savepoint-per-user transaction isolation (session.begin_nested), Keycloak token caching with 401 retry in execute_request(), httpx boolean serialization edge case requiring 'true' string (CR-019), and IDP_MANAGED_ENABLED guard that blocks all mutation endpoints. Bumped from L to XL by 'Affects authentication/authorization' red flag.

29 files changed (diffstat: 29 files changed, 2163 insertions, 17 deletions). 9 modified existing files, 20 new files (coordinator, entrypoint, Dockerfile.sync, Helm CronJob, requirements-sync.txt, 6 coordinator test modules, 4 router/service guard test modules, docs, __init__ files). 16+ maps to XXL on the file-count scale.

API (user_management_router.py, common.py, projects.py), Service (authentication_service.py, user_access_service.py, coordinator.py), DB-Persistence (coordinator writes users, memberships, projects via existing repositories), Infrastructure (Dockerfile.sync multi-stage build, sync-cronjob.yaml Helm CronJob), External (KeycloakClient.list_users() paginating Keycloak Admin API). Five distinct architectural layers; bumped from XL to XXL by the same Keycloak integration red flag.

requirements-sync.txt is a new file but pins only packages already present in pyproject.toml (httpx, pydantic-settings, sqlalchemy, asyncpg, sqlmodel, langchain-core). pyproject.toml is not in changed_files — no new packages added to the project, only minor config addition.

red_flags_applied: Affects authentication or authorization: IDP_MANAGED_ENABLED guard blocks all mutation endpoints across routers and services — Technical Risk bumped from L (4) to XL (5).

Integration with new external service: Keycloak Admin API used as a scheduled sync data source (list_users pagination, full user/membership reconciliation), a new integration pattern beyond the existing auth-only client — Component Scope bumped from XL (5) to XXL (6) and Affected Layers bumped from XL (5) to XXL (6).
split_recommendation: Work already implemented. Advisory: by-component (by-dependency order) — sync-container (coordinator + entrypoint + Dockerfile.sync + Helm CronJob) deliverable first as the foundational piece, then api-guards (IDP_MANAGED_ENABLED flag + require_no_idp_lock across routers/services) as the second slice, since the guard depends on the feature flag introduced alongside the coordinator.
